notes.title: Bugfix Update version 1.10
notes.content:
Hi there!

We made another Update for If Fusion Were That Easy!

Also, a big Thanks to the people reporting, thank you so much for the support.

Small Changelog:

- the last hotspot you've hovered over sometimes remains on the screen
- bug where the bartender can come back before solving the puzzle if leaving the scene
- rare bug when talking to Rapelli for the first time
- various other small fixes

notes.title: Bugfix release
notes.content: Fixed some rare bugs. Thanks for the report!

notes.title: Feedback Update 2
notes.content:
Changes since the last Update:
- fix Robo mini-game bug
- Steam Achievement "cold fusion"
  -> if you need a savegame to claim it really fast
       you can find it on your discord: [url=https://discord.gg/eR4kMdg79w]https://discord.gg/eR4kMdg79w[/url]
- font error on a specific scene scene
- bug where you are able to get a key twice (library)
- escape from Gastrap without solving it
- cloud Saves
- dialog bug at the end of Chapter 4
- other small reported bugs

notes.title: Feedback Update
notes.content:
- add Option to mute voices
- enhanced tutorial Graphics
- show the Mouse tutorial on the Options Menu if Gamepad is off
- fixed player motion while in Dialog mode
- fixed issue with hidden Items
- some Bugfixes
